pyq_bad.why: garbled: stem and options mixed with an unrelated Ghori/Prithviraj question

patterns: APPSC asks the reign period of Vikramaditya VI (1076-1126 CE) with close-number distractors.
Mitakshara = Vijnaneshwara's commentary on Yajnavalkya Smriti, written at Vikramaditya VI's court - the most repeated fact.
Other PSCs use book-author matches (Bilhana - Vikramankadevacharita) and 'medieval jurists' lists with Rajasekhara as the trap.
App MCQs go wider (temples at Itagi/Lakkundi, successor powers, Khazipet inscription) - reasonable AP/Kakatiya tilt but beyond PYQ depth.
